expectations.text: Does not fabricate a verdict; asks what "the new approach" and "what we have" refer to (or otherwise requests the missing context).
expectations.evidence: grader 1: "I can't give you a verdict yet. Your message doesn't say what either approach is... Any answer I gave now would be a guess." followed by a numbered list asking "What you have now: what it is..." and "The new approach: what it is...". The only stance offered is a clearly-labelled default heuristic ("Until then, the default rule is: keep what you have unless..."), not a verdict on the unspecified approaches. | grader 2: The response opens with "I can't give you a verdict yet. Your message doesn't say what either approach is, and a council has to know what it's voting on." and explicitly requests details on both "What you have now" and "The new approach" before proceeding.
